Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXXVII OF 1999
PUNJAB SMALL INDUSTRIES
CORPORATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE; 1999
ORDINANCE XXXVII OF
1999
An Ordinance further to amend the
Punjab Small Industries Corporation Act, 1973
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 27th July, 1999]
No. Legis: 3(XXXVII)/99, dated 27-7-1999.--
The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is .hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Punjab Small Industries
Corporation (Amendment) Ordinance, 1999.
(2) It shall come into force at
once

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Small Industries Corporation Amendment Ordinance 1999
sections.description:
Amendment of section 16 of Act XV of 1973

ORDINANCE XXXVII OF 1999
PUNJAB SMALL INDUSTRIES
CORPORATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE; 1999
ORDINANCE XXXVII OF
1999
An Ordinance further to amend the
Punjab Small Industries Corporation Act, 1973
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 27th July, 1999]
No. Legis: 3(XXXVII)/99, dated 27-7-1999.--
The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is .hereby
published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 16 of
Act XV of 1973.--In the Punjab Small Industries Corporation Act, 1973 (XV
of 1973) in section 16 in subsection (4) after the words "absence by
the" the words "Vice Chairman and in the absence of both the"
shall be inserted.
